verdict.rationale: Galileo's release notes document annotation queues that organize sessions, traces, and spans for structured review by subject matter experts. Its marketing page says it captures SME annotations into datasets, which covers routing, review, and labeling. The evidence is thin, coming only from a release note and a marketing claim. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how items are routed to queues (manual vs. rule-based or SDK/API), label schema and annotation workflow details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can route outputs to human annotation queues for review and labeling

citations.quote: Organize sessions, traces, and spans into queues for structured review by subject matter experts, making it easier to scale human feedback across your AI applications.
Capture subject matter expert annotations to create a living asset that continuously grounds your AI systems.
